title: Verify R439 interleaved window through carry-aware packet routes
body:
PR2407's live COPY window has no logical MOVE, but executing its target updates through complete packets still requires routing. This package binds the exact 303 undo ADDs and ten snapshot taps to a conditional packet contract and a new finite GL2(Z/9) routing implementation. The prescribed schedule has **929 route actions**, 313 packet XORs and 616 fresh-copy disposals; every route must protect the live snapshot and parked ancestors.

The finite compiler includes low/high carries and nonidentity source/target return charts, emits adjacent record swaps, and checks all 431,568 target records in both forward and inverse fragments against the separate split-word/full-ring oracle. It also checks 248,832 route cases. Five semantic faults reject: omitted carry, omitted return, transient snapshot borrowing, unowned writes and a wrong tap cut. Fresh buffers are explicitly cleared.

This completes one bounded part of PR2437's handoff. It is **not** a uniform GL64 compiler, complete supplier invoice, runtime improvement or new kappa. The ledger uses explicit record-action tariffs; bit/control/tape costs, rank-seven COPY/ERASE, full selected owner admission and recursive workspace remain open. The nominal 941-to-929 route-count comparison is not a weighted-time claim.

## Review and validation

Start with `research/r439-interleaved-packet-routing/README.md`, `REVIEW.md` and `RESULT.json`. The separate mathematical reviewer derived the conditional implication, inspected the code and replayed it on Python3.14.6. That is separate execution, not an independently implemented engine or human review.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-interleaved-packet-routing
make selected-record-check
```

Both pass locally; the registered optimized replay includes all controls. Source hashes and frozen predecessor Git blobs are pinned. The selected record and upstream sources are unchanged. Hosted CI is separate.

Credit Jose Manuel's PR2195 three-route/complete-packet contract, alephnan's PR1627 and cheesegrader's PR540 common-frame arguments, Ross Richardson's PR2407/2437, starship-s's PR2421 native execution, and the retained supplier/exporter lineage. The PR2407 constructor is explicitly reused. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including the mathematical reviewer; Apache-2.0.

Base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority4. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2401#discussioncomment-18946844). PR2440's different multi-column word is outside this source binding. No merge or selected-frontier change is requested by this contribution.
